card.name: Inside surnames and place names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a proper name, usually a surname or place name that is still unfinished, where a hyphen, comma, initial or another name could follow. It is common in reference lists and news text.

modes.label: Surname in citations
modes.description: Partway through an author's surname in a reference list, just before the initials.

modes.label: Names in news text
modes.description: Inside a person's or place's name in running text, sometimes before a hyphenated second name.
modes.example: Waleska Bat<<ista>>-Arias, the former district technology coach

card.writes: It favors name continuations such as ' &', hyphen joins and ' III', which fit a name followed by a co-author or a second name part.
card.plain: It marks a surname or place name that is not finished, such as an author's name in a reference list.
